TCS (CodeVita)
CSE (3.8-7 LPA) (Naushad K.H)
> Managerial Rounds
During the managerial round, the interviewer may first ask if you are comfortable working with new technologies that would be available in the future.
* You will be asked to present your resume, which tech stack you used to build your projects, and why you chose that.
* You will be asked to show GitHub codes and host links of the projects and what difficulties you faced during the making of the projects.
* They might ask for an overview and a brief description of the programs you had created, and might question them.
* How do you resolve workplace conflicts within a team working on the same project?

* Situation-based questions like, if you are just given the role of writing reports will you still be willing to join TCS or if your job role is completely non-technical will you be willing to take it.
* What are 7 different layers of the OSI Reference Model?
* Difference between TCS and UDP.
* Difference between IPV4 and IPV6.
* What is Kernel
* What is the candidate key and unique key
* Give DDL, and DML commands example
* What is Truncate, Delete and Drop
* What does mean to the system? out.println meaning in JAVA.
> HR round:
* Why TCS, and what do you know about TATA?
* Whether I will be willing to relocate, and how will I manage the things like food and all?
* Asked me to show my college id card and mark sheets for verification.
* Your internship were paid?
* What was the mode of payment?
* Was it included in PF?
* Where are you from, how do you come here, where you are staying?
* Willing to relocate, will you work on the Support project, Night shift, or any education gap?
